title: wolfHSM key_size field not validated against server at setup time
description: wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t.key_size is set by the caller at alloc time and used to size PKCS#1 v1.5 padding in hsm_sign. There is no verification that key_size matches the actual RSA modulus size on the wolfHSM server. A provisioning error (wrong key_size) causes: hsm_sign applies padding to the wrong modulus length → server rejects the padded message (wrong length for the key) → operation fails. This is fail-safe (no security breach), but the error message gives no hint about the mismatch. Consider calling wh_Client_RsaGetSize at setup time to validate. Alternatively, document that key_size is the caller's responsibility.
